standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 10549-10552)
standard_prerequisites.use: Lifts a specialization between generic points to a specialization in the presenting scheme.

standard_prerequisites.name: The characterization of points through generic points of a smooth presentation
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Used inside the counted proof (source lines 10537-10543)
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces a third generic point of the space from a generic point of a component of the presentation.

core_obligations: Reduce to the irreducible case: the two points with mutual specializations have the same closure, and the reduced closed substack on that closure is decent, so one may replace the stack by it (proof lines 10525-10533)

Produce a third generic point: a smooth presentation of the presentation's affine scheme maps a generic point of a component through one of the two given points onto a generic point of the space (proof lines 10534-10543)

Conclude: by symmetry it suffices to show that two of the generic points coincide; the specialization lifting lemma lifts the relevant specialization to the presentation, where a generic point of a component cannot specialize to a distinct point, so the points agree (proof lines 10545-10556)
proof_roadmap: 先把问题约化到不可约情形（两点的闭包相同，其上既约闭子栈仍 decent）。
取仿射概型 U 与光滑态射 U → X，取过 u_1 的不可约分支的泛点 u_3，其像 x_3 也是 X 的泛点。
由对称性只需证 x_1 = x_3；用特殊化的提升引理把 x_1 ⇝ x_3 提升到 U 内的特殊化，而泛点不能特殊化到别的点，故相等。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that the topological space of a decent algebraic stack is Kolmogorov, that is, two points each specializing to the other must coincide (author lemma at source lines 10518-10523, label lemma-kolmogorov). The proof (source lines 10525-10557) reduces to the irreducible case through the decent reduced closed substack on the common closure, introduces a generic point of the space coming from a generic point of a component of a smooth presentation, and uses the specialization lifting lemma to force equality of generic points (proof lines 10525-10556). The reduction and the lifting of specializations through a presentation are the content. H3.
